To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
consumption of a functional food enriched with a carob fiber extract (20 g /L), in a milk matrix, improves the lipid profile and the bowel function in humans, without adverse effects.

the consumption of a milk matrix enriched with a non extractable rich tannate carob fiber (400 mL daily for 28 days) significantly increased HDL cholesterol and total cholesterol levels in the group with normal cholesterol levels and significantly increased LDL cholesterol levels.
the functional food containing PF 1 (R) has the ability to reduce triglycerides, total cholesterol and LDL cholesterol in the blood and to improve bowel function in humans.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of functional food enriched in carob fiber (Ceratonia siliquae L.), which has a beneficial effect on the lipid profile of the volunteers and on bowel function, and is therefore suitable for use as a preventive measure for the development of cardiovascular diseases and constipation.
the design of new functional foods based on carob fiber, which are capable of improving lipid profiles and bowel function.

the development of functional foods that can help to prevent the development of chronic diseases such as cardiovascular diseases, obesity and diabetes, and to improve the health and wellbeing of the population.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a daily consumption of 20 g of non extractable tannaestrich carob fiber (Ceratonia Siliqua L. in a milk matrix (Biosearch S.A) could be useful for improving the lipid profile and intestinal transit in humans.
the consumption of a functional food containing carob fiber, as a milk drink, has a beneficial effect on lipid profile and bowel health.
the use of this type of functional food could contribute to a better quality of life in people who are at risk of suffering from cardiovascular diseases and/or suffering from constipation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a functional food containing 20 g/L of PF 1(r) can have a positive influence on the lipid profile of volunteers and improve bowel function.
carob fiber is a functional ingredient that can be incorporated into a dairy matrix and can be used as a food for the prevention of cardiovascular diseases.
the consumption of a milk matrix with 20 g of carob fiber / L for 4 weeks improves bowel function in humans and tends to reduce triglyceride and total cholesterol levels.
